articleHtml:
Nando’s nutrition starts with a decision that is different from most chicken restaurants: which cut of flame-grilled chicken do you want?

A quarter breast, quarter leg, half chicken, boneless breast, thigh skewer, or wings can all provide very different calories and protein before you add PERi Chips, Portuguese Rice, Garlic Bread, PERi Mac, sauce, or another side.

Then comes the heat level.

Nando’s marinates its chicken in PERi-PERi for 24 hours and flame-grills it to order with the heat level you choose. That makes the chicken cut, portion, baste, and sides more useful calculation inputs than one generic “Nando’s chicken calories” number.

Use the Nando’s Nutrition Calculator above to match the exact chicken, sandwich, bowl, side, sauce, and serving size you actually order.

Start With the Chicken Cut, Not the Heat Level

The chicken portion makes one of the largest differences in a Nando’s meal.

Current U.S. menu values include approximately:

PERi-PERi Chicken

Calories

1/4 Chicken, Leg

260

1/4 Chicken, Breast

320

Two 1/4 Chicken Legs

520

1/2 Chicken

560

Two 1/4 Chicken Breasts

640

Boneless Butterflied Chicken Breast

390

Chicken Thigh Skewers

480

3 Chicken Thighs

660

12 PERi-PERi Wings

1,190

The difference between a quarter leg and half chicken is much larger than the difference created by a small vegetable topping or condiment.

Choose the correct chicken portion first.

Breast and Leg Are Not Interchangeable

Nando’s separately lists its breast and leg portions because they do not have identical nutrition.

The current:

1/4 Chicken Breast: about 320 calories

and:

1/4 Chicken Leg: about 260 calories

are different portions.

Likewise, ordering two breasts is not nutritionally equivalent to ordering two legs.

If you know which pieces you ate, use those exact records rather than an average quarter-chicken estimate.

Half Chicken Gives You Both Cuts

The 1/2 Chicken is one of Nando’s signature choices.

Nando’s describes it as flame-grilled, skin-on chicken that includes both breast and leg portions, so you do not need to choose only one cut.

The current U.S. menu lists the 1/2 Chicken at approximately:

560 calories

before separately selected sides are considered.

That means:

1/2 Chicken

and:

1/2 Chicken + PERi Chips

are different nutrition calculations.

Heat Is a Flavor Choice, but Baste Still Matters

Nando’s lets customers choose their preferred PERi-PERi heat.

Depending on the current menu and location, choices can include milder preparations through increasingly hot PERi-PERi options.

The restaurant’s PERi-PERi sauces use ingredients including chilli, salt, garlic, lemon, onion, oil, and vinegar.

Do not assume every sauce or baste is nutritionally identical merely because it is used on the same chicken.

If NutritionSolver has a verified separate value for the chosen baste, apply it to the calculation.

If the published entrée nutrition already includes the restaurant’s standard preparation, do not add the same baste again.

Hotter Does Not Automatically Mean More Calories

Spice intensity and calorie content are different things.

A hotter PERi-PERi sauce does not automatically contain more calories than a milder one.

For example, current packaged Nando’s Hot and Garlic PERi-PERi sauces are only about 5 calories per teaspoon, while creamy PERinaise contains considerably more energy because it is a mayonnaise-style product.

Choose sauces according to their actual nutrition rather than ranking them by heat alone.

PERinaise Is Different From PERi-PERi Sauce

This distinction matters.

PERi-PERi sauces are chilli-based sauces.

PERinaise is a creamy PERi-PERi mayonnaise-style spread.

Nando’s current packaged Original PERinaise contains about:

45 calories per 3-teaspoon serving

with approximately:

4g fat

2g carbohydrates

190mg sodium .

That makes PERinaise nutritionally different from a small serving of standard hot PERi-PERi sauce.

If you add PERinaise to a sandwich, chips, or side, calculate it separately when it is not already included in the recipe.

Chicken Breast Sandwich Is a Complete Recipe

The current Chicken Breast Sandwich is approximately:

500 calories

and is served with ingredients including arugula, tomato, pickled onions, and PERinaise.

It should therefore be calculated as a finished sandwich rather than:

chicken breast + generic bread

unless you are specifically modifying the standard recipe.

If you remove PERinaise or add another ingredient, adjust only the component that changes.

Thigh & Mighty Uses Two Boneless Thighs

The current Thigh & Mighty Sandwich is approximately:

740 calories .

It uses two boneless thighs along with arugula, tomato, pickled red onions, and PERinaise.

That is a distinctly different build from the Chicken Breast Sandwich.

The chicken cut matters here as much as the bread and spread.

The Chicken “Burger” Is Its Own Menu Item

Nando’s current Chicken “Burger” is listed at approximately:

600 calories .

Do not merge it with the Chicken Breast Sandwich simply because both use chicken and bread.

Different sandwich recipes can use different sauces, vegetables, cheese, chicken portions, or other components.

Keep each current named sandwich as its own searchable record.

Garlic Bread CLT Is More Than Garlic Bread

The current Garlic Bread CLT contains approximately:

730 calories .

It combines pulled chicken, cheddar cheese, arugula, and tomato on buttery garlic bread.

This is not the same thing as ordering Garlic Bread as a side.

NutritionSolver should keep:

Garlic Bread CLT

and:

Garlic Bread

as completely separate entities.

Wrap Calories Depend on the Recipe

Current Nando’s U.S. wraps include recipes such as:

Sweet & Spicy Chicken Wrap: about 840 calories

Spicy Chicken Caesar Wrap: about 790 calories

Sweet Potato Halloumi Wrap: about 800 calories

These are complete recipes with different proteins, cheeses, dressings, vegetables, and sauces.

A wrap should not be calculated from the tortilla alone.

Choose the exact named wrap first.

Vegetarian Does Not Automatically Mean Lower Calorie

The current Sweet Potato Halloumi Wrap is vegetarian but still contains approximately:

800 calories .

The current Veggie Burger is around:

520 calories .

Ingredients such as halloumi, creamy sauces, hummus, avocado, oils, breads, and other components can make vegetarian meals substantial in calories.

Dietary category and calorie level are separate questions.

Bowls Need Current Recipe-Level Nutrition

Nando’s current menu includes several bowl formats.

Current headline values include approximately:

PERi-PERi Chicken Bowl: 490 calories

Rainbow Bowl: 790 calories

PERi Power Bowl: 800 to 1,040 calories depending on the configuration.

The Rainbow Bowl currently includes ingredients such as avocado, tomato-cucumber-onion salad, pickled cauliflower, hummus, feta, Superseed Crunch, Spiced Rice, and Lemon & Herb PERi-PERi.

That combination is why it should use its own current recipe rather than being reconstructed from an older generic bowl record.

A Bowl With Added Protein Needs Clear Labeling

If a bowl allows optional chicken, thighs, halloumi, or another protein, NutritionSolver should distinguish:

base bowl

from:

bowl + selected protein .

Do not show a protein-added bowl under the same name as the base recipe without explaining what is included.

A strong UI would use:

Choose Bowl → Choose Protein → Add Extras

where the menu actually supports that customization.

Side Size Can Double the Calories

Nando’s sides commonly have Regular and Large servings.

Current menu ranges show approximately:

PERi Chips: 330 to 660 calories

Portuguese Rice: 150 to 300

Garlic Bread: 370 to 740

Coleslaw: 230 to 460

Red Skin Mashed Potatoes: 170 to 340

PERi Mac: 320 to 640

Brussels Sprouts: 90 to 180

PERi Honey Sweet Potatoes: 420 to 840.

In many cases, the Large serving is around twice the Regular portion.

Always choose the actual size rather than using one generic side record.

PERi Chips Need Size and Dip

PERi Chips are one of the most common additions to a Nando’s chicken meal.

Current menu nutrition starts at approximately:

330 calories for the Regular serving

and reaches roughly:

660 calories for Large .

Nando’s also sells versions paired with PERinaise or PERi Ranch.

That means these should remain separate:

PERi Chips

PERi Chips + PERinaise

PERi Chips + PERi Ranch

A dip is not automatically included in plain-chip nutrition.

Portuguese Rice Can Be a Lighter Side Than Some Richer Options

The current Portuguese Rice ranges from approximately:

150 calories Regular

to:

300 calories Large .

That is a very different calorie contribution from Garlic Bread, PERi Mac, or PERi Honey Sweet Potatoes.

This is why side choice often changes the total meal more than changing one small topping.

The New Tomato and Cucumber Side Is Its Own Current Item

Nando’s current menu also includes a newer Portuguese Tomato & Cucumber Salad at approximately:

35 calories .

That item should have a separate current database record.

Do not reuse an older generic salad value simply because the ingredient names overlap.

Hummus With PERi-PERi Drizzle Can Be a Large Shareable

Current Hummus with PERi-PERi Drizzle is listed across approximately:

680 to 1,080 calories

depending on the serving configuration.

It is easy to mistake an appetizer or shareable for a small dip.

The serving label needs to make it clear whether the value represents:

individual portion

or:

larger shared order .

Halloumi Sticks Are a Substantial Starter

Current Halloumi Cheese Sticks with Chilli Jam contain approximately:

660 calories .

If they are shared, calculate only the portion you personally eat.

If you eat the full order before your entrée, add the whole serving to the meal.

Wings Need the Current Piece Count

The current menu prominently offers:

6 PERi-PERi Wings with PERi Ranch

and:

12 PERi-PERi Wings

along with wing platters.

The current six-wing order with PERi Ranch is approximately:

670 calories .

The current 12-wing order is approximately:

1,190 calories .

An older 5-piece or 10-piece wing record should not automatically be treated as the current menu serving.

Piece count must appear directly in the item name.

Platters Need Shared-Meal Logic

Nando’s current U.S. menu includes:

Full Platter: approximately 1,480 to 3,080 calories

Family Platter: approximately 2,080 to 4,480

Jumbo Chicken Platter: approximately 2,500 to 5,060

Wing Platter: about 2,380

PERi-PERi Wings & Chips Platter: about 2,840.

These ranges exist because platter sides and configurations can vary.

A family platter should never be displayed as though its total belongs to one person.

A useful calculator should let the user select the shared platter and then either:

calculate the whole order

or:

estimate the portion eaten by one person .

Kids Meals Need Included-Item Transparency

Nando’s current Nandino’s menu pairs a kids entrée with a side and kids drink.

Current choices include chicken wings, grilled chicken breast strips, grilled cheese, mac and cheese, chicken breast sandwich, and grilled drumstick and thigh.

If the calorie figure represents only part of the meal while the menu name mentions a side and drink, NutritionSolver should clearly explain the serving definition.

Do not let users assume a headline entrée number always represents every possible side and beverage combination.

Desserts Need Current Recipe Values

Current desserts include:

Naughty Nata: about 150 calories

and:

Triple Chocolate Dream Brownie: about 250 calories.

These should be added separately to an entrée calculation.

A chicken-and-sides meal does not automatically include dessert nutrition.

Limited-Time Saka Items Need Their Own Status

Nando’s current U.S. menu is promoting the limited-time PERi-PERi Saka Sauce , created in collaboration with Bukayo Saka.

The live menu currently includes limited-time items such as:

The Wingman

Match Plate

and:

Saka Special .

These should be stored under:

Current Limited-Time

rather than mixed permanently into the core menu.

When the promotion ends, move them to Historical instead of leaving them as normal current menu items.

Nando’s Nutrition Questions

How many calories are in a Nando’s half chicken?+
How many calories are in a quarter chicken?+
How many calories are in Nando’s PERi Chips?+
Does the Nando’s heat level change calories?+
How many calories are in the Thigh & Mighty?+
How many calories are in a Nando’s Rainbow Bowl?+
Are Nando’s sauces calorie-free?+
How should I calculate a Nando’s platter?+

Build the Nando’s Plate in the Right Order

Start with the exact chicken cut, wings, sandwich, wrap, bowl, or salad .

Then confirm the portion or piece count and your selected PERi-PERi preparation .

After that, add the exact Regular or Large sides , plus any PERinaise, PERi Ranch, hummus, extra sauce, or starter you consume.

Finally, account for a drink, dessert, or shared platter portion if it is part of your meal.

That ordering sequence gives a much more useful Nando’s nutrition result than relying on one generic calorie number for flame-grilled chicken.
